notes: This invoice bundles 3 separate real Faktur Pajak, printed as pages 2-4 of invoice_3.pdf and also split out as invoice_3_fp_admin_fee.pdf / _water.pdf / _electricity.pdf: Admin Fee (fp 04002600279925528, Harga Jual 20,000.00, PPN 2,200.00), Water (fp 08002600279925080, 277,390.00, PPN 30,513.00 — WAIVED), Electricity (fp 08002600279925110, 4,741,120.00, PPN 521,523.00 — WAIVED). taxable_amount is the sum of the three Harga Jual (5,038,510.00) and matches invoice_3's own total_amount_before_vat exactly — an internal-consistency observation only, NOT a match source (an FP is not independent of the vendor's own billing; see ai_reasoning.taxable_amount). vat_amount is 2,200.00 — the Admin Fee's PPN only — because water and electricity are VAT-exempt under PP 49/2022 (see ai_reasoning). This AGREES with invoice_3's stated vat_gst of 2,200.00; it is not a discrepancy. Do NOT match against the invoice's final TOTAL (5,080,938.00), which adds denda and the Admin Fee's PPN.

ai_reasoning.vat_amount: Electricity and clean water are VAT-exempt strategic goods under PP 49/2022, so both FPs carry the “PPN Dibebaskan” stamp — their computed PPN (30,513 water + 521,523 electricity = 552,036) is for tax reporting only and is waived. Electricity's only carve-out is residential supply above 6,600 VA, which doesn't apply to a commercial tenant. So the payable VAT is the Admin Fee's 2,200 alone — exactly the invoice's own stated VAT.
ai_reasoning.taxable_amount: Sum of the three FPs' Harga Jual (Admin Fee 20,000 + Water 277,390 + Electricity 4,741,120) = 5,038,510, which equals the invoice's Total Bulan Berjalan. NOTE: this is an internal-consistency check only — it is NOT a valid match source for Total Amount Before VAT, because an FP's Harga Jual is derived from the vendor's own billing calculation, not independent of it. Matching needs a contract value or an independent supporting document; with neither, the field must fail to manual review.
